title: Portuguese Cod Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew from Portugal, featuring cod as the main ingredient. This dish is perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the crushed tomatoes, fish broth, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low.
Add the cod fillets and simmer for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
